step.title: A few quick questions
step.body: Boba asks only what your profile can't answer — the fields that rank and tailor your applications. Every question can be skipped.
ask.hint: No AI right now? The standard questions are below; answer them yourself.
status.skipped: Skipped. Anything that depended on this answer is a little less certain now.
question.eligibility: Where can you legally work without a new visa?
question.cefr: How well do you speak this language?
question.notice_period: How much notice do you owe your current employer?
question.writing_sample: Paste a short sample of your own writing so drafts sound like you.

languages.title: Draft the other language
languages.body: These facts have only one language variant. Boba can draft the other one for you to review.
